title: An international consulting hub for entering Belarus and the EAEU
lead: We build working connections between Italian manufacturing and the Belarusian market. Official status, an international team and end-to-end support.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: We understand both sides of the market and help Italian companies connect with the right people, businesses and institutions. We support the journey from understanding a market to making a concrete business contact and working together further.

people.name: Mario Ubaldi
people.about: Italian business consultant with 30 years of experience. He specialises in financing, grants and the internationalisation of Italian companies. He speaks Italian, English, French and Portuguese.

people.name: Viktoria Gubanova
people.about: An expert in international business communication and cross-cultural relationships. She has built partnerships between European companies and the Belarusian market, organised exhibitions and business missions, and worked with embassies and government institutions.

status.title: Official status
status.text: Official representative of the National Agency of Investment and Privatization of the Republic of Belarus (NAIP) in Italy.
items: direct access to Belarusian businesses and their actual needs
information on incentives and government support measures
the ability to arrange meetings with government bodies

items.title: Official status
items.text: NAIP representatives in Italy, with direct access to government support.

items.title: Three languages
items.text: We work in Russian, Italian and English.

items.title: Two markets, one team
items.text: We live and work in Italy and Belarus, and understand both sides.

items.title: End-to-end support
items.text: From market research to supplying retail chains, with a single team.

items.title: Checks before introductions
items.text: We check counterparties for reliability and sanctions risks before you invest time in a meeting.

items.title: A network of vetted specialists
items.text: Accountants, interpreters and other specialists are available on request.

seo.title: About us — VIKUB
seo.description: We build working connections between Italian manufacturing and the Belarusian market. Official status, an international team and end-to-end support.

experts.title: Our expert network
experts.text: For each project, we engage trusted specialists: lawyers, accountants, logistics professionals and interpreters. This allows us to offer clients only the expertise they actually need.
